rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an odd or strange thing or idea.

example.english: I really can't figure out this oddity.
example.traditional: 呢件古怪嘢我真係估佢唔到。
example.jyutping: ne1 gin6 gu2 gwaai3 je5 ngo5 zan1 hai6 gu2 keoi5 m4 dou3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a strange or eccentric person.

example.english: They always talk to the birds alone; they’re a real oddity.
example.traditional: 佢成日一個人對住啲雀講嘢，真係個怪人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 jat1 go3 jan4 deoi3 zyu6 di1 zoek3 gong2 je5 zan1 hai6 go3 gwaai3 jan4
